## Claims
- [source-backed] For \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) with \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), Theorem 4.8 gives two integral generating families for \(J_v\subset\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 847-892]
- [source-backed] The paper explicitly says: “the techniques utilized in [GR02] seem very particular to the case where \(X_w\) is defined by inclusions. We do not know how to use them for some alternate approach to the case of general \(X_w\) considered in this paper.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 928-937]
- [source-backed] In the inspected window, `[GR02]` occurs both in the inclusion-case discussion and in the open-method remark. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 893-901; 934-937]
- [source-backed] Conjecture 4.10 asserts minimality of both Theorem 4.8 families and reports computer verification for \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-946]
- [source-backed] The stronger statement \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\) is presented as a suspicion, followed by “So far a proof has eluded us.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 956-975]
- [unsupported] No supplied source identifies `source-30`, supplies its prior extraction, or specifies an all-document keyword set; hence completeness of that extraction cannot be verified from the available record.

## Strategy
The inspected external full text matches the current \(J_v\), \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), \(i,j,a,b\), and two-family setting. A bounded literal audit of lines 893–975 finds `[GR02]` at lines 900 and 934, `Conjecture 4.10` at lines 942, 945, 947, and 955, “We do not know” at line 936, and “proof has eluded us” at lines 974–975.
